title: Exhaust retries — DLQ and failure table record
description: A structurally valid JSON is sent to the clientes queue, but with a non-UUID client code. This is a permanent validation error: the Lambda will reject it on every attempt. After 3 delivery attempts (1 original + 2 retries), SQS moves the message to the dead-letter queue. On the third and final attempt the Lambda also writes a record to the falhas_processamento table with tipo_erro=permanente.

expect.outcome: permanent error after 3 attempts — DLQ receives the message; failure table receives a record
expect.wait: 6-9 minutes for the full retry cycle to complete with the default 180-second visibility timeout

dlq.note: Exactly one message must appear here.

dynamodb.note: A record keyed by the SQS messageId must exist with tipo_erro=permanente, tentativas=3, and corpo_original containing the original message body.
